executiveSummary: Multiple, concurrent edge-device and OT controller compromises elevate the near-term risk of industrial process disruption. Actively exploited remote-access appliances (Ivanti Connect Secure, BeyondTrust Remote Support, F5 BIG-IP APM, Citrix NetScaler) are providing initial access, persistence, and lateral movement opportunities that can bridge IT into OT where segmentation is weak. Security Advisory Security Advisory Direct OT targeting continues: a joint advisory warns of active attempts to access Siemens S7 PLCs using S7comm and commodity libraries, creating potential for logic tampering and unsafe states-especially in water utilities. Security Advisory Industrial gateways with critical unauthenticated control paths remain exposed. Recent CISA bulletins detail multiple RCE and missing-auth conditions in Advantech EKI-1242 protocol gateways and WISE-6610 LoRaWAN gateways, enabling remote takeover of industrial conduits if unpatched. Security Bulletin Security Bulletin Refrigeration control systems in France were actively compromised, prompting rapid removal of internet exposure; older Danfoss models and outdated firmware are implicated, threatening cold-chain integrity. Security Advisory View Article Mass exploitation of enterprise platforms continues to drive extortion and potential supply-chain impact. ShinyHunters abused a new Oracle PeopleSoft flaw at scale, impacting government and aviation-adjacent services; defenders should patch and normalize URL decoding at WAFs to catch evasion. Supporting Report View Article Nation-state and criminal campaigns persist. Chinese government-linked operators and a Gunra ransomware RaaS are both active against critical sectors; immediate patching of VPNs/edges, MFA enforcement, and segmentation remain essential. items: Chinese government-linked operators leveraging botnets, VPN infrastructure, and LOTL techniques against critical sectors; anticipate continued edge exploitation and stealth persistence. Security Advisory
Gunra ransomware affiliates exploiting Fortinet SSL-VPN, using Impacket/RDP/SMB for lateral movement, and exfiltrating Microsoft 365 data pre-encryption. Security Advisory
ShinyHunters mass-exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft (CVE-2026-35273) leading to cross-sector extortion including aviation-adjacent systems; WAF URL-encoding evasion observed. View Article

relevance: Risk to industrial operations this week is elevated by: (1) active PLC targeting with potential ladder-logic tampering; (2) widely deployed OT gateways with unauthenticated control/RCE; and (3) exploited perimeter/VPN/support appliances that often broker access to control environments. Cold-chain incidents demonstrate tangible operational impact beyond data loss, while enterprise platform mass exploitation (PeopleSoft) amplifies extortion and supply-chain exposure.

items: Advantech EKI-1242EIMS/IEIMS protocol gateways: multiple unauth RCE/missing-auth/cleartext management and OPC UA DoS weaknesses. Security Bulletin
Advantech WISE-6610 LoRaWAN gateways: remote command injection (public exploits) enabling device takeover. Security Bulletin
F5 BIG-IP APM OAuth server: CVE-2026-94127 actively exploited; unauth RCE; hotfixes and iRule available. Security Advisory
Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway: CVE-2026-88771/88772 RCEs exploited; patch and investigate. Security Advisory
Danfoss iC7 drives: insecure engineering/debug interfaces allow unsigned app/EEPROM/firmware upload-operational disruption risk. Security Bulletin
Ivanti Connect Secure: CVE-2026-104935 auth bypass with active exploitation; factory-reset/forensics guidance provided. Security Advisory
BeyondTrust Remote Support: CVE-2026-102764 auth bypass (KEV); patch BT26-05-RS; hunt for persistence. Security Advisory

descriptions: Exploit Public-Facing Application (ATT&CK T1190): Ivanti, NetScaler, BIG-IP APM, PeopleSoft.
Valid Accounts (T1078): VPN/session hijack, OAuth app abuse; BeyondTrust, ConnectWise OAuth incident (M365 tenants). View Article
Remote Services (T1021): WinRM/RDP/SMB lateral movement; DCSync (T1003.006); Impacket atexec; portproxy.
Command and Control via Application Protocols (T1071): MQTT/Matrix for backdoor C2; potential crossover to OT MQTT. View Article
ICS-specific: S7comm reads/writes against Siemens PLCs; OT gateway takeover enabling protocol manipulation; refrigeration controller abuse.

outlook72h: Expect continued scanning and exploitation waves against NetScaler, Ivanti, BeyondTrust, and BIG-IP appliances; prioritize patch/containment windows and compromise assessment. Monitor OT edges (Advantech EKI/WISE) for anomalous admin actions and firmware changes; deploy temporary ACLs and IDS signatures. Hunt for S7comm anomalies and unauthorized logic uploads on Siemens PLCs; validate golden program backups. Cold-chain operators: validate controller exposure removal, credential changes, and alarm integrity; stage manual failovers.
